(define contains?
  (lambda (x l)
    (if (null? l)
        #f
        (if (= (car l) x)
            #t
            (contains? x (cdr l))))))

(contains? 3 '(1 2 3 4))     ; #t
(contains? 9 '(1 2 3 4))     ; #f
